Tünelcilik Tunnelling Semineri Seminar

Vaka Analizleriyle with Case Studies

Tünel Tasanm, $artname, Tunnel Design, Guidelines, Yapim ve Sözlesmesei Pratikler Construction and Contractual Practices

AMAC SCOPE

Türkiye'de farkli sektörler tarafindan projelendirilen ve insa edilen tünellerin büyük gogunlugu Yeni Avusturya Tünel Acma Metodu (NATM) kullanilarak yapilmaktadir. Karayollari Genel Müdürlügü $artnamelerinde kullanilan NATM projelendirme kriterleri, Avusturya $artnameleri temel alinarak hazirlanmistir.

Principals of New Austrian Tunnelling Method (NATM) is generally being applied in the design and construction of the tunnels by different sectors in Turkey. The NATM design criteria used in the Specifications öf the General Directorate of Highways is based on Austrian Specifications.

NATM projelendirme ve yapim sartname kriterlerinde gelistirilen uygulamalar ve édinilen tecrübeler konusunda sektör paydaslarina bilgi aktarimini saglamak amaciyla, Avusturyali uzmanlar tarafindan 31 Mart - 1 Nisan tarihleri arasinda verilecek bu seminerin katilimcilara faydali olmasini dileriz.

Austrian experts will conduct a seminar in order to disseminate the experiences on the modifications in NATM design and construction specifications and on practices developed according to the new specifications between 31th March and 1st April. We wish you a fruitful seminar.

Prof.Dr. Wulf $CHUBERT

Graz Teknoloji Universitesi

Graz Teknoloji niversitesi insaat Múhendislii Fakültesinden mezun oldu. Doktora derecesini Leoben Maden niversitesinden aldi. 12 yildir uluslararasi danismanlikhizmeti veren bir sirkette, dünya genelindéki bircok projede, agirlikli olarak yol tünelleri, demiryolu tünelleri, metrolar, madenler ve sevler konularinda tasarimci, müsavir ve danisman olarak calismaktadir. 1992 yilindan itibaren Graz Teknolöji niversitesi Kaya Mekanii ve Túnelcilik Enstitúsú Baskanidir. Calisma konulari agirlikli olarak zayif ve fayli ortamlarda tünelcilik, zemin karakterizasyonu ve gözlemlemedir. ISRM'nin eski Baskan Yardimcisi olan Prof. Schubert, halen Avusturya Geomekanik Derneginin Baskanidir.

Prof.Dr. Wulf SCHUBERT Graz University of Technology

Wulf Shubert graduated from Civil Engineering Faculty, Graz University of Technology. He received his PhD from the Mining University Leoben. He has been. working for 12 years for an international consulting company on a large number of projects, mainly tunnels for roads, railways and metros, caverns, mines, and slopes around the world as designer, Engineer, and consultant. Since 1992 he is head of the Institute for Rock Mechanics and Tunnelling at the Graz University of Technology. The focus of his research is on tunnelling in poor and faulted ground, ground characterization and monitoring. He is past Vice President of the ISRM and currently president of the Austrian Society for Geomechanics.

Bernhard KOHLBöCK IGT

Bernhard KOHLBóCK IGT

Viyana Teknoloji niversitesi insaat Mühendisligi Fakültesinden mezun olmustur. Is hayatina 2002 yilinda IGT Danismanlik $irketinde proje mühendisi olarak baslamistir. 2012 ylindan itibaren ayn sirketin yöneticisi ve ortagi olarak calismaktadir. Zor jeolojik sartlar altinda tünelcilik projeleriylé Avusturya'da ve yurtdisinda 13 yill askin sürede tecrübe sahibi olan Kohlböck, projelendirme ve proje yönetiminden sorumludur. IGT'deki görevlerinin yani sira mesleki derneklere úyelikleri ve bircok yayini bulunmaktadir.

Bernhard Kohlböck graduated from Civil Engineering Faculty, Vienna University of Technology. He started his career at IGT Consulting Engineers in Salzburg in 2002 as a project engineer. Šince 2012 he is Director and Partner of the company. With more than 13 years of experience in tunnelling projects in Austria and abroad and partially under difficult geological conditions, Mr. Kohlböck is responsible for detailed design as well as overall project management. Besides his activity at IGT he is a member of professional associations and author of numerous publications.

Dr. AIfred FASCHING 3G Gruppe Geotechnik Graz ZT GmbH

Graz niversitesi Mühendislik Jeolojisi Bölümünden 1987 yilinda Yüksek Lisans derecesiyle mezun oldu. Uluslararasi danismanlik hizmeti veren bir sirkette 9 yil calistiktan sonra Graz Teknoloji Universitesinde Kaya Mekanigi ve Tünelcilik Enstitüsünde arastirmaci olarak calisti ve 2000 yilinda doktora derecesini aldi. Fasching, 3G Gruppe Geotechnik firmasinda 20 yildir mühendis ve 15 yildir genel müdür olarak calismaktadir. Zayif, saglam, baskili ve kaya patlamasi olan ortamlarda yapilan projelerde, dizayn, yeralti arastirmalari, modelleme, kaya kütle karakterizasyonu ve yapim sirasinda danisman olarak görev almistir.

Dr. AIfred FASCHING

3G Gruppe Geotechnik Graz ZT GmbH

Alfred FASCHING graduated in Engineering Geology from the Graz University in 1987 (MSc). Following a 9 year employment in an international consulting company, he was researcher at the Institute for Rock Mechanics and Tunnelling, Graz University of Technology, receiving his PhD in 2000. Since 20 years he is professional engineer and since 15 years managing director of 3G Gruppe Geotechnik Graz ZT GmbH, an international consulting company. He has experience in the design of underground investigation programs, ground modeling, rock mass characterization and consulting services during construction for projects in soft ground as well as hard, squeezing and bursting rock.

Hanns WAGNER (MSc) OBB, Avusturya Federal Demiryollari

Hanns WAGNER (MSc) OBB, Austrian Federal Railways

Graz niversitesi Insaat Múhendislii Bölúmúnden Yüksek Lisans derecesiyle mezun oldu. 2007 yilindan beri Avusturya Federal Demiryollarinda büyük tünel projelerinde uzman olarak calismaktadir. Agirlikli olarak, 33 km uzunlugundaki cift tüplü Koralm Tüneli, 6 km uzunlugundaki cift tüplü Granitztal ve St. Kanzain tüneli gibi lakustrin (göl) kili ortaminda yer alan farkli kisa tünellerdé görev almaktadir.

Hanns Wagner finished his studies in civil engineering at the Graz University of Technology with the Masters degree. Since 2007 he is working in an expert role on the large tunnel projects of the Austrian Federal Railways (ÓBB). His present focus is on the double tube Koralm tunne! (33 km), double tube tunnel chain Granitztal (6 km) and Several shorter tunnels of the tunnel chain St. Kanzian, which are all situated in lacustrine clay.
